facts.fact: The government presented a digital transformation roadmap of twelve flagship projects to 2030 at a government seminar on 25 August 2025 titled En route pour 2030; the article names no adopting act.
facts.system: digital transformation roadmap with 12 flagship projects (En route pour 2030)

facts.fact: The roadmap sets twelve projects with a 2030 horizon, including zero white zones, zero data abroad, zero buildings unconnected, zero paper, zero cash, zero unprotected critical infrastructure, a unique digital identity for every citizen, AI, IT talent and digital literacy; the article gives no costs.
